attribution_text: Source: Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India (via India Data Portal, ODC-By; data.gov.in, GODL-India).
notes: This is the same DES district/season APY series that the widely mirrored Kaggle 'crop_production.csv' (1997-2015, ~246k rows) was taken from (data.gov.in catalog above, published 24/05/2013, updated 06/07/2021); the IDP file extends it to 2022-23 with 455k rows, so the old mirror was not downloaded.
data.gov.in resource download requires login/API key; data.desagri.gov.in and upag.gov.in are interactive report UIs without a stable no-login bulk CSV, hence the IDP CKAN download.

Area = hectares. Production column is labelled 'Tonnes' on every row of the 1997-2023 file, but implied yields prove: Cotton(Lint) = bales of 170 kg (ratio to UPAG tonnes = 5.88), Jute/Mesta/Sannhamp = bales of 180 kg, Coconut = number of nuts. Convert (x0.170 / x0.180) or model coconut in nuts/ha.
Season 'Total' rows (48,044) are sums of the other seasons for the same district-year-crop - drop them to avoid double counting. Seasons: Kharif, Rabi, Summer, Autumn, Winter, Whole Year.
yield column is Tonnes/Hectare in the 1997-2023 file but kg/ha in the UPAG file; safest is to recompute yield = production/area.
Production missing 1.1%, zero 0.9%; area never missing. Horticulture crops (orange, papaya, grapes, pomegranate) only appear 2002-03..2014-15 and in few districts.
IDP notes some crop names map to more than one crop code; group by crop_name, not crop_code.
District names change over time (new districts carved out); use district_code (LGD-mapped) when joining years.
